tools.install: winget install Git.Git   (Git for Windows; the probe is tested against it)
winget install Rustlang.Rustup   (then: rustup default stable-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
winget install astral-sh.uv   (runs make_large_tree.py and extract_failures.py)
winget install NASM.NASM   (the aws-lc-sys crates in quarto-hub need it)
winget install Kitware.CMake   (the aws-lc-sys crates in quarto-hub need it)
Visual Studio Build Tools, "Desktop development with C++" (cargo finds link.exe itself, so absent from PATH is normal; install only if the build says "linker not found")
fnm/nvm; Node major per .nvmrc (only some quarto tests use it)

items.title: the gate during a real git switch of a 4,000-file tree
items.proves: The controller reports the gate closed for every real marker git creates during a switch of a large tree, and releases it afterward (six switches). The skip-never-delete behavior for an unreadable file is a hub behavior, covered by a5.
items.does_not_prove: Antivirus or OneDrive interplay, or timings on a cold cache.

items.title: core.autocrlf=true: classifier and arrival comparisons
items.caveat: core.autocrlf is input, not true: the CRLF-checkout case was not exercised from the checkout. The tests set autocrlf=true in their own temp repos, so they still check the comparison, but reclone with: git clone -c core.autocrlf=true ... for the full item.
items.proves: A CRLF-checked-out file compares equal to its blob content after normalization, through the classifier and the arrival comparison, for text; binaries compare by bytes.
items.does_not_prove: .gitattributes filters (LFS, ident), or the CRLF case if autocrlf was not true (the script marks that caveat).

items.title: paths and keys: registry keys and hub path_keys
items.caveat: core.longpaths is (unset), not true: git operations on paths over 260 characters may fail for reasons unrelated to the code.
items.proves: Registry keys use /; a case-insensitive collision of two keys falls back to ordinary sync; drive letters, UNC prefixes, and long paths (with core.longpaths) round-trip.
items.does_not_prove: NTFS 8.3 short names or Unicode normalization differences.

items.title: hub gate and checkpoint integration with a real repo
items.proves: The gate inside sync_all holds with a real repo; the checkpoint is written before the pointer flips; no code path renames a directory while it holds a handle in it; the unreadable-file test (an injected PermissionDenied, a skip and never a delete) passes on Windows. The injected error stands in for a real sharing violation; a real one needs a second process holding the file open.
items.does_not_prove: Network filesystems or Dev Drive behavior.
